data.want: 林道を走れる 2 人乗りの小さな電動のオフロード車両 (電池で走る 4 輪、最高 40 km/h、500 kg まで、積載 150 kg)

requirements.name: 路面の摩擦係数 (砂利)
requirements.basis: assumption (gravel; no public value found)

requirements.name: 路面の粗さ (ISO 8608 のクラス)
requirements.basis: assumption: the forest road taken as ISO 8608 class C. ISO 8608 covers unpaved roads too (https://www.iso.org/standard/71202.html); class C = 128-512 x 10^-6 m^3 at n0 = 0.1 cycle/m from the table in https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12544-013-0127-8 (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 縦の坂 (止まって発進できる一番急な坂)
requirements.basis: 林道規程 (林野庁) 第 20 条: 縦断勾配 12 % は第 1 項のただし書、14 % は第 4 項の 2 級林道の例外 (the steepest stretch), https://www.rinya.maff.go.jp/hokkaido/keikaku/other/attach/pdf/sinrinkeikaku_taikei-32.pdf (the article and its paragraphs read for this repository). The sustained 12 % is the forest loop's grade_high in data/catalog/tests.yaml (P4, T1, T2)

requirements.name: 横の傾き
requirements.basis: assumption (no basis found)

requirements.name: 段差
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 横風 (瞬間)
requirements.basis: 気象庁の風の強さの目安で、瞬間風速 30 m/s (平均風速では 20 m/s) とする (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 気温 (範囲の高い端)
requirements.basis: assumption (the hot end of a -10 to 40 degC range of use)

requirements.name: 人数と荷重の組 (見る組)
requirements.basis: request (2 人乗り、積載 150 kg)
requirements.note: MVP は two_cargo (2 人 + 荷) だけを見る。empty・driver・two はまだ見ない。乗員と荷は設計の部品 (kind occupant / cargo)

requirements.name: 体格の範囲
requirements.value: 若年女性 5 % 〜 若年男性 95 %
requirements.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 体重 (強さの不利側)
requirements.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, 項目 N1 体重, 若年男性 95 パーセンタイル, https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html (read against the table, 2026-11-03)

requirements.name: 積載
requirements.basis: request
requirements.note: 乗員とは別の荷として扱う (聞いていない)

requirements.name: 荷の重心の高さ (荷台の床から)
requirements.basis: the demo design's cargo: its box centre at 600 mm stands 150 mm above the deck's top at 450 mm (data/designs/offroad-4w-v1.json, parts cargo and deck)

requirements.name: 最高速度
requirements.basis: request

requirements.name: 0 → 最高速度 (Q50) の時間
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 停止距離
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from 細目告示 第171条 第5項 (初速 35 km/h), https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/content/S171.pdf; the table is for vehicles of 25 km/h or less and others, not for this vehicle's class (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 止まっていられる坂
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from 細目告示 第171条 第5項, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/content/S171.pdf; the table is for vehicles of 25 km/h or less and others, not for this vehicle's class (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 航続
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 最低地上高
requirements.basis: EU 規則 168/2013 附属書 I (全地形車 L7e-B の下限), https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2013/168/annex/I (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 倒れない角度 (Q30 の組で)
requirements.basis: fully loaded (two_cargo, as Q30): 24 deg from ROHVA 1 and ANSI B71.9 as summarized in the CPSC staff briefing of 2016-11-22 (PDF p.11), which also gives 33 deg for two people (both read on that page for this repository); 35 deg empty: an assumption (no source found)

requirements.name: 安全率 (降伏に対して)
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 挟み込みの隙間
requirements.basis: ISO 13854:1996 の試し読み, https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/22598/44d1054ccf4f41e1adefb8020dbaaa13/ISO-13854-1996.pdf (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 衝突の速さ
requirements.basis: assumption (the top speed, Q50)

requirements.name: 手の操作部に掛かる力 (握る点、前後・上下・回す向きのそれぞれ)
requirements.basis: assumption: UN Regulation No. 79 (1988 text), table "Steering control effort requirements" (M1, with a failure: 300 N) taken as the largest hand force in use (the table was read; using it as a design load is the assumption)

requirements.name: 手の操作部の握る点の動きの上限 (Q66 の力で)
requirements.basis: assumption (the range where the feel and position of the control do not change; no source)

requirements.name: 足の操作部に掛かる力 (踏む面、踏む向き)
requirements.basis: UN Regulation No. 13-H, Annex 3, 2.1.1 and 2.3.4 (50 daN, read by the intake department on 2026-11-03)

requirements.name: 足の操作部の踏む面の支えの動きの上限 (Q68 の力で)
requirements.basis: assumption (small against the control's travel; no source)

requirements.name: 公道を走るか
requirements.basis: assumption of this fixed file; Q70 is a required question and was not asked

requirements.name: 乗員と部品に掛かる横の加速度
requirements.basis: CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, § 1422.3(e) (0.70 g; read by the intake department on 2026-11-03). The vehicle's own peak from its dynamics tests counts instead when it is larger

requirements.name: 乗員と部品に掛かる前後の加速度
requirements.basis: CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, § 1422.3(b)(1) (peak braking coefficient 0.90; read by the intake department on 2026-11-03). The vehicle's own peak counts instead when it is larger

requirements.name: 乗員の肩・腰の位置 (点 R) を外へ押す力 (10 s)
requirements.basis: CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, § 1422.5(c)(1)-(5) (read by the intake department on 2026-11-03)

requirements.name: Q77 の力を除いたあとの点 R の永久の横の変形の上限
requirements.basis: CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, § 1422.5(c) (less than 25 mm; read by the intake department on 2026-11-03)

requirements.name: 出荷の形
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 乗員の空間の荷重の基準の質量 M (横 1.75 M J・後ろ 1.4 M J・上 20 M N)
requirements.basis: assumption (the R4 builder's M). The coefficients 1.75, 1.4 and 20 are OECD Standard Code 4 (February 2026), 3.5.2.1, 3.5.3.1, 3.6.1 (read), borrowed from tractors >= 600 kg; they stay in the R4 builder, the contract having no unit J/kg or N/kg for them

requirements.name: 泥や石を放す踏面の範囲 (車軸の真上から前へ)
requirements.basis: 道路運送車両の保安基準の細目を定める告示 (2023.9.22 版) 第178条 第2項 第1号 (read); a public-road rule for other traffic, borrowed: applying it to the occupants is an assumption

requirements.name: 泥や石を放す踏面の範囲 (車軸の真上から後ろへ)
requirements.basis: the same 第178条 第2項 第1号 (read; borrowed, an assumption as Q87). The tread above the axle beyond this arc counts too (assumption)

requirements.name: 悪路の走行距離 (疲労)
requirements.basis: assumption (no public basis found)

data.want: 林道を走れる 2 人乗りの小さな電動のオフロード車両 (電池で走る 4 輪、最高 40 km/h、500 kg まで、積載 150 kg)

picks.reason: 置・走・悪 に当てはまるので、S1 静的な転倒 (傾斜台・縁の荷重)・S2 旋回での転倒 (J ターン・定常円)・S3 回避 (ダブルレーンチェンジ)・S4 制動と前のめり・S5 凸凹の横斜面 を当てる
走・池 に当てはまるので、P1 段差を越える・P2 坂を登る・坂で発進する・P3 加速・最高速度・P4 航続・稼働時間 を当てる
外・走 に当てはまるので、F1 横風・F2 空気抵抗 を当てる
乗・走・悪 に当てはまるので、C1 壁への正面衝突・C3 横転したときの乗員の空間 (横・後ろ・上から押す) を当てる
預・荷・走・乗・悪・池 に当てはまるので、R1 静的強度・R2 衝撃 (落錘・落下・段差)・R3 疲労・耐久・R4 横転時の保護枠 (ROPS)・R6 電池の取付の振動・R7 操作部の荷重 (手と足の力を枠まで伝え、動かない)・R8 荷重の通り道 (部品と乗員の重さと加速度を枠まで伝える) を当てる
振・乗・走・電・預 に当てはまるので、N1 固有振動数と加振・N2 乗り心地・N3 騒音 を当てる
池・続・電 に当てはまるので、T1 電池の温度・T2 モーター・制御器の温度 を当てる

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「板金の決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: 曲げの内側の半径は板厚以上
rules.basis: a rule of thumb in sheet-metal design guides (inside bend radius not smaller than the sheet thickness); no single primary source was read (assumption)

rules.text: 穴の中心から板の縁までの距離は板厚の 2 倍以上
rules.basis: a rule of thumb in sheet-metal design guides (hole centre to edge at least twice the thickness); no single primary source was read (assumption)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「締結の決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: ボルト穴の中心から縁までの距離は穴径の 1.2 倍以上
rules.basis: EN 1993-1-8 Table 3.3: minimum end and edge distance e1, e2 = 1.2 d0 (recalled; not checked in this repository)

rules.text: 鋼どうしのねじのかみ合い長さは呼び径以上
rules.basis: a rule of thumb for steel screwed into steel; no single primary source was read (assumption)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「溶接の決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: 溶接する角形・円形の鋼管の外形は肉厚の 35 倍以下
rules.basis: EN 1993-1-8 section 7: the tabulated resistances of welded hollow-section joints hold for b/t and h/t up to 35 in the usual case (recalled; not checked in this repository)

rules.text: すみ肉溶接の長さは、のど厚の 6 倍と 30 mm の大きい方以上
rules.basis: EN 1993-1-8 4.5.1: a fillet weld is not shorter than 30 mm or 6 times its throat thickness (recalled; not checked in this repository)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「公差の決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: 組み合う部品の隙間は、公差の積み上げより大きい
rules.basis: ordinary tolerance-stack practice (assumption); no single primary source was read

rules.text: 固定のボルトの位置の公差は、(隙間穴の径 - ボルトの径) / 2 以内
rules.basis: ASME Y14.5 formula for fixed fasteners, T = (H - F) / 2 (recalled; not checked in this repository)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「人の決まり」から 3 件の規則

rules.text: 座面の幅は、座位殿幅 (若年女性 95 %) 391 mm 以上
rules.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, 座位殿幅, https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html (not checked in this repository)

rules.text: 座面の奥行きは、座位殿・膝窩距離 (若年女性 5 %) 406 mm 以下
rules.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, 座位殿・膝窩距離, https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html (not checked in this repository). The seat box may include the back, so a hit is a question to the designer, not a verdict

rules.text: 動いて閉じる隙間は、指が入る 25 mm より小さくしない
rules.basis: ISO 13854:1996 (finger 25 mm), https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/22598/44d1054ccf4f41e1adefb8020dbaaa13/ISO-13854-1996.pdf (not checked in this repository)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「電池の決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: 使う気温の高い側は、LiFePO4 セルの上限 55 degC 以下
rules.basis: EVE LF50K datasheet: cell temperature up to 55 degC, https://www.rcscomponents.kiev.ua/datasheets/LF50K32V50AhProduct%20Specification.pdf (not checked in this repository). Q19 is the hot end of the range of use, so this is a first screen; the thermal tests (T1) judge the cell temperature itself

rules.text: 電池の電圧は 60 V (直流) 以下。超えると高電圧の扱いが要る
rules.basis: UN R100 voltage class B starts above 60 V DC (recalled; not checked in this repository), https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/un/UN_R100.pdf

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「組み立ての決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: 1 人で持ち上げる部品は 23 kg 以下
rules.basis: NIOSH revised lifting equation, load constant 23 kg (Waters et al., Ergonomics 36(7), 1993) (recalled; not checked in this repository). A hit means two people or a lifting aid are needed

rules.text: 部品の箱は地面より下に出ない
rules.basis: a check of the geometry (the origin is on the ground), not taken from a source (assumption)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「サスの決まり」から 2 件の規則

rules.text: サスのストロークは、通る段差の高さ (Q15) 以上
rules.basis: engineering assumption, not taken from a source; Q15 is the step height in mm

rules.text: 荷を載せた静的なたわみは、サスのストローク以内
rules.basis: engineering assumption: the whole mass is shared equally by the supports and the spring is linear, so the static deflection is load / stiffness

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「製造の決まり」から 1 件の規則

rules.text: 角形鋼管の肉厚は、規格品の下限 1.6 mm 以上
rules.basis: JIS G 3466 square and rectangular steel tubes are made from 1.6 mm up (recalled from product tables; not checked in this repository)

text: 最初から入っているナレッジ「系の決まり」から 9 件の規則

rules.text: 走る製品は、動力源から駆動輪まで、トルクを伝える鎖が切れずにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum for a self-propelled product (the driven wheels, support.actuation.drive, are reached from the motor or engine by links that carry torque); not taken from a standard

rules.text: 人が乗って走る製品は、ハンドルから操舵輪まで、操舵の鎖が切れずにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a steering input reaches every steered support). Steering equipment of road vehicles is regulated (UN Regulation No. 79 is the one recalled); not checked in this repository

rules.text: 走る製品は、制動の入力から制動する輪まで、制動の鎖が切れずにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a brake input reaches every braked support). Braking of road vehicles is regulated (UN Regulation No. 13-H and Japan's 道路運送車両の保安基準 are the ones recalled); not checked in this repository

rules.text: 人が乗る製品は、座席が骨組みにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a seat is joined to the frame by some chain of links)

rules.text: 人が乗る製品は、座席ごとに拘束 (シートベルトなど) が座席と骨組みにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (each seat has a restraint joined to the seat and to the frame). Occupant restraints are required of road vehicles by Japan's 道路運送車両の保安基準 and of recreational off-highway vehicles by ANSI/ROHVA 1 (both recalled; not checked in this repository)

rules.text: 人が乗って屋外の悪路を走る製品は、乗員を囲む転倒保護の枠 (ROPS) が骨組みにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a roll-over protective structure is in the design and joined to the frame; that it encloses the occupants is not checked here). ANSI/ROHVA 1 asks for one on recreational off-highway vehicles (recalled; not checked in this repository)

rules.text: 公道を走る製品は、前照灯・尾灯・制動灯・方向指示器がそろう
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (one of each in the design). Lamps of road vehicles are regulated by Japan's 道路運送車両の保安基準 (recalled; article numbers and counts per side not checked in this repository)

rules.text: 電池を積む製品は、電池からモーターまで、電力を伝える鎖が切れずにつながる
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (the motors are reached from a battery by links that carry power)

rules.text: 電池を積む製品は、電力の鎖に遮断 (ヒューズかスイッチ) がある
rules.basis: assumption: HIRAKU's minimum (a fuse, switch, contactor or breaker is on the battery's power chain). Electric propulsion safety is covered by ISO 6469-3 (recalled; not checked in this repository)

text: 要件のファイルのまま進みます (既定値で足した 2 件: Q57・Q63)

answers.basis: EU 規則 168/2013 附属書 I (全地形車 L7e-B の下限), https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2013/168/annex/I (not checked in this repository)

answers.basis: ISO 13854:1996 の試し読み, https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/22598/44d1054ccf4f41e1adefb8020dbaaa13/ISO-13854-1996.pdf (not checked in this repository)
